name: Black Galaxy
shortDescription: Deep obsidian natural granite embedded with naturally occurring golden-bronze crystalline speckles.
description: Black Galaxy is an iconic natural granite celebrated for its deep midnight ground and shimmering mineral flecks. Its dense igneous composition provides high resistance to everyday wear, making it a timeless choice for modern kitchens, islands, and architectural accents.

name: Absolute Black
shortDescription: Uniform pitch-black granite offering sleek minimalism and architectural contrast.
description: A monolithic, ultra-dense natural granite renowned for its consistency and pure jet-black depth. Perfect for clean lines, monochrome architectural themes, and high-contrast interior cabinetry.

name: Tan Brown
shortDescription: Warm earthy granite featuring chocolate, terracotta and black mineral clusters.
description: Rich in earth tones, Tan Brown granite blends deep chocolates, burnt sienna, and charcoal accents. It complements warm wooden cabinetry, classical aesthetics, and resilient heavy-traffic flooring.

name: Kashmir White
shortDescription: Soft off-white canvas with gentle silver veining and garnet red micro-crystals.
description: An airy and luminous natural granite presenting light grey-white tones sprinkled with delicate burgundy flecks. It brightens kitchens and residential spaces while preserving natural stone resilience.

name: River White
shortDescription: Flowing grey and pale lavender ribbons running across a soft ivory background.
description: River White is admired for its dynamic linear motion reminiscent of flowing stream currents. Its subtle lavender and smoky grey ribbons bring organic movement to modern kitchen peninsulas and expansive flooring.

name: Alaska White
shortDescription: High-drama icy white granite with bold onyx and warm taupe mineral formations.
description: A striking architectural granite that merges icy crystal whites with bold dark charcoal patches and subtle warm taupe undertones. Ideal for statement islands and feature walls.

name: Indian Statuario
shortDescription: Opulent white marble with expressive grey feathery veins and natural luminosity.
description: Indian Statuario marble is a prestigious natural stone known for its bright crystalline ground and dramatic grey ribbons. Each slab is a unique piece of earth artistry, delivering timeless grandeur to grand foyers, living rooms, and master suites.
colorTone: Pure White with Dramatic Grey Veins

name: Italian Carrara
shortDescription: Classic European marble with soft smoky veining across a cool grey-white ground.
description: The quintessential marble of classical architecture and Renaissance sculpture. Italian Carrara offers soft, feathered grey striations that impart understated sophistication to bathroom vanities, fireplace surrounds, and elegant floor patterns.
colorTone: Cool White with Soft Grey Mist

name: Makrana White
shortDescription: Historic calcitic Indian marble revered for pure white crystal radiance and durability.
description: Celebrated worldwide for its historical heritage in iconic Indian monuments, Makrana marble possesses a high percentage of pure calcium carbonate that never yellows with age. It develops a rich, soft patina over decades of gentle use.

name: Botticino
shortDescription: Warm Italian beige marble with golden hazel veins and gentle ivory clouds.
description: Botticino marble is synonymous with Mediterranean warmth and quiet luxury. Its creamy beige base, enriched by subtle golden threads, creates inviting, warm residential environments that soften architectural minimalism.
colorTone: Warm Creamy Beige with Golden Veins

name: Glossy Vitrified Tiles
shortDescription: High-sheen reflective floor tiles engineered for maximum light bounce and seamless expanse.
description: Engineered with nano-coating technology, our Glossy Vitrified tiles offer an immaculate mirror reflection that amplifies natural light and enhances space perception in modern apartments and commercial reception halls.

name: Matte Architectural Tiles
shortDescription: Anti-glare tactile ceramic surfaces with refined slip-resistance and soft organic touch.
description: Matte tiles present an understated, glare-free finish that feels velvety to touch and provides natural anti-slip security. Ideal for wet zones, contemporary Scandinavian interiors, and covered terraces.

name: Vitrified Slabs & Tiles
shortDescription: Heavy-duty homogeneous vitrified tiles with uniform composition from surface to base.
description: Designed for demanding environments, vitrified body tiles retain their color and integrity even after prolonged heavy foot traffic. Highly resistant to chemicals, abrasion, and thermal shifts.

name: Large-Format Slabs
shortDescription: Expansive porcelain panels (e.g. 1200x2400mm) delivering minimal grout lines and continuous elegance.
description: Large-format porcelain slabs replicate the continuous grandeur of natural marble slabs with reduced weight and zero porosity. Excellent for seamless bathroom feature walls, kitchen backsplash walls, and uninterrupted floor vistas.

name: White Quartz
shortDescription: Pristine non-porous engineered surface with unmatched stain resistance and luminous uniformity.
description: Formulated from 90%+ natural quartz crystals combined with advanced polymers, White Quartz delivers an immaculate, non-porous surface that never needs sealing. Impervious to wine, turmeric, lemon and oil stains in modern kitchens.

name: Calacatta-Style Quartz
shortDescription: Bold marble veining paired with maintenance-free engineered quartz performance.
description: Captures the dramatic theatricality of Italian Calacatta marble while offering the zero-maintenance resilience of engineered quartz. Broad sweeping grey and charcoal veins traverse a warm milk-white surface.
colorTone: Warm Milk White with Bold Calacatta Veins

name: Grey Quartz
shortDescription: Urban concrete-inspired grey quartz providing industrial chic without porous maintenance.
description: Blends urban sophistication with organic warmth. Grey Quartz offers subtle tone-on-tone textures that pair exceptionally well with matte black fixtures, smoked oak cabinetry, and brass accents.

name: Beige Quartz
shortDescription: Warm sandy cream quartz creating a soothing, gentle neutral foundation.
description: Designed for organic modern interiors seeking soft warmth over stark contrast. Beige Quartz integrates micro-specks of feldspar to yield a tranquil sand-dune aesthetic with superior stain and scratch resistance.
